implemented: Consume new matched packet timing after every authenticated TWCC report, including reports that do not advance contiguous packet credit. Frame/image/layout ACKs remain independent.
Use receiver-clock delivery intervals and sender-clock offered load with actual conservative wire costs. Sender and receiver clock origins are never subtracted as absolute one-way latency.

Use the installed aiortc interarrival/overuse detector as a congestion trend, with a nearest100ms throughput anchor, at least9200 wire bytes and a bounded180ms history. Do not use its application-limited AIMD estimate as an available-capacity ceiling.

Robust relative transit baseline is bounded to600 reports/60seconds. A50ms arrival gap rebuilds the delivery window; estimator freshness expires after1.5seconds. Microsecond interval arithmetic avoids clock-origin-dependent rounding.

Moderate slowdowns keep100ms excess-transit allowance. A delivery rate below half the offered load keeps the earlier50ms response. Actual byte volume, slower delivery and overuse must agree; a draining queue cannot cut again.

Retain QSM active recovery, one-second cut spacing, first healthy interval, post-congestion cooldown, shared/legacy viewer guards and independent RTCP-loss handling. Codec dwell/quiet, full-desktop quality and encoded/RTP payloads are unchanged.
